integrity: Theorem and proof concern independent loss markers, open boundaries and pointwise joint logarithmic scaling; finite checker enumerates small volumes but is not an infinite proof. Date 2026-07-03 refers to the earliest publicly verified motivating sparse-loss paper.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the finite Bernoulli rare-region survival surrogate with prescribed inverse-power decay rates. Does not establish microscopic Lindblad or quantum trace-distance asymptotics; no finite-size control of the physical coarse-graining error.
title: Sharp quenched–annealed cutoff for finite Bernoulli Griffiths survival
